verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾਣੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baabaanee peeRee chalee gur chele parachaa parachaiaa|

en.bdb: The line of Baia Nanak increased and the love between Guru and disciples further developed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te gur chelaa chelaa gur bhaiaa|

en.bdb: Guru Angad came of the limb of Guru Nanak and the disciple became fond of Guru and the Guru of the disciple .

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: amaradhaas gur a(n)gadhahu satigur te satiguroo sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: From Guru Ahgad came out Amar Das who was accepted Guru after Guru Angad Dev.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur amarahu gur raamadhaas gur sevaa gur hoi samaiaa|

en.bdb: From Guru Amar Das came Guru Ram Das who through his service to the Guru absorbed in the Guru himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਹੁ ਅਰਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raamadhaasahu arajan guroo a(n)mirat birakh a(n)mirat fal laiaa|

en.bdb: From Guru Ram Das emerged Guru Arjan Dev as if from the ambrosial tree was produced ambrosia.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜਨਹੁਂ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: haragovi(n)dh gur arajanahu(n) aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: Then from Guru Arjan Dev was born Guru Hargobind who also preached and spread the message of the primal Lord.
The sun is ever perceptible; it cannot be concealed by any one.
